items.title: Correctly matched vocabularies vs. estimated close rate
items.description: In the L1/L3 scenario there are 3 stakeholders in the room: a CFO, an ops lead, and a founder. The first meeting used one generic framing and matched none of their vocabularies — a lukewarm response. The second meeting translated the same capability for all three — a yes. This models a simple, illustrative relationship: as more of the stakeholders in the room hear their own accountability addressed directly, the estimated chance the deal moves forward rises — starting from a low baseline (a generic pitch still occasionally lands) and climbing steeply as each additional stakeholder gets a correctly aimed translation.

params.name: matchedStakeholders
params.label: Stakeholders whose vocabulary was correctly matched

items.compute: const base = 15; const perMatch = 22; const rate = Math.min(base + params.matchedStakeholders * perMatch, 95); return { closeRate: rate };
